We checked orthodontists all over Chiangmai and this was the only one who said it was too early for my daughter to start treatment. Wait until her jaw stopped growing.
When we did start there (of course!) we were told it would take 2 years, which it did exactly!
Receptionist didn't speak English, which was inconvenient, and the braces came off a couple of times, at our additional expense.
Otherwise highly recommended.
This is a truly honest dental clinic with a very kind doctor who gives excellent advice. I'm bookmarking this place for my family to receive care from Dr. Ailef.

Dr. Surachai is kind, highly skilled in orthodontics, and the results are beautiful. He pays attention to detail, and the final result is stunning. He explains the before and after results with detailed examples—unlike anyone else! He cares for patients like family. Plus, there's convenient and spacious parking. Anyone who doesn't get their braces from Dr. Surachai is missing out big time!
